LanguageData.RTDC_QuickAutoExportTip: If checked, log will be auto-exported to HTML when the 200 limit is reached.\nIf unchecked, the log will simply be cleared without saving.
LanguageData.RTDC_EnableModDesc: Toggle all coloring features on or off.
LanguageData.RTDC_ShowHistoryTabDesc: Show 'Chat Log' tab in the main button bar.
LanguageData.RTDC_AutoExportHistoryDesc: Automatically export log to HTML when limit (200) is reached.
LanguageData.RTDC_EnableBubblesSyncDesc: Apply colors to Interaction Bubbles mod.
LanguageData.RTDC_EnableRimTalkNameColoringDesc: Colorize names in the RimTalk dialog box.
LanguageData.RTDC_EnableChatColoringDesc: Colorize keywords and actions in chat.
LanguageData.RTDC_OpenHistoryWindowDesc: Open a floating window to view chat logs.
LanguageData.RTDC_UseFactionColorDesc: Prioritize using the pawn's faction color.
LanguageData.RTDC_AutoFavColorDesc: Use pawn's favorite color (DLC) if available.
LanguageData.RTDC_EnableRainbowDesc: Enable animated rainbow text status effect.
LanguageData.RTDC_EnableBWDesc: Enable black and white text status effect.
LanguageData.RTDC_DrinkSoup: drank the clear soup and text returned to normal.
LanguageData.RTDC_PathInvalid: Path is invalid or does not exist.
LanguageData.RTDC_BracketStyleDesc: Set independent color and style for text inside specific symbol pairs. Higher priority than default action/kaomoji styling.\ne.g. Add 「 」for inner thoughts, ~ ~for actions.
LanguageData.RTDC_ShowDirectionalArrowDesc: Show arrow-to-recipient on the RimTalk Overlay chat. New RimTalk already renders this natively, so keep OFF. Legacy RimTalk users should turn ON.
LanguageData.RTDC_EnableRelationEffectsDesc: Show a relationship status badge (Lover ❤, Rival ☠, Friend ★) in front of the name when specific relationships exist between speaker and recipient.
LanguageData.RTDC_ShowDirectionalArrowHistory: Show Directional Arrow in History / Exports
LanguageData.RTDC_ShowDirectionalArrowHistoryDesc: Show the [Speaker ➔ Recipient] arrow in the history window and TXT/HTML exports, independent of the main arrow toggle. ON by default.
LanguageData.RTDC_ShowDirectionalArrowVerticalDesc: When the main directional arrow is ON, stack names vertically as [A-> newline B] so long names don't compress the chat width. OFF = single-line [A -> B]. Only visible when the main arrow toggle is enabled.
